name: Studio CLI (library, packs, skills, servers, websites, releases, WordPress)
description: Search, import and save assets in the Studio asset library (the user's own library plus the Global Space), use packs, read and save skills (the user's know-how for recurring tasks), deploy/control Node.js servers (multiplayer, storage, APIs) for the project's apps, and publish web apps and games as websites on the user's domains (with HTTPS certificates); make numbered releases of the project (version, changelog, git tag, kept exports) and work with the project's WordPress (own plugins and themes from starters, exports, PHP log).

commands.description: find reusable assets
files, description and tags of an asset
copy an asset into this project (default: assets/library/<name>)
save project files/folders as a new asset in the user's library
find instruments, samples, models, materials … in installed packs (reference: pack-id/item-id)
all items of a pack with details
absolute file path of a pack item
scaffold a new pack in packs/<id>/ of the project
validate + install a project pack as the user's personal pack
the user's skills for this area — know-how to load before a matching task
read a skill (then follow it)

commands.usage: studio skill new <name> · studio skill save <SKILL.md>
commands.description: write a workflow down as a skill and save it for the user (they call it with /name)
current user and project
list the Studio tools installed in this environment
Node.js server for the app (multiplayer, saves, leaderboards, APIs) — from a template
deploy/redeploy the server: copy, npm install, (re)start; prints the public URL and log

commands.usage: studio service status | logs [--tail N] | restart | stop | start
commands.description: control the project's server
environment variables (secrets) of the server

commands.usage: studio site publish [--root dist] [--build "npm run build"] [--spa]
commands.description: publish the project as a website (new release, prints the addresses); options are saved
website addresses, release, settings and the last publish log
domains of the website (DNS A/AAAA → this server); check tests that they reach the Studio

commands.usage: studio site set [--root …] [--build "…"] [--spa|--no-spa] [--name <name>] · studio site offline|online
commands.description: website settings, take it offline / back online
HTTPS certificate of each domain (issuer, days left, errors); issue = request/renew now
the project's version, its releases and what changed since the last one
make a numbered release when the user asks for one: VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, git tag, a copy of exports/
WordPress projects: is it installed, its address, the own plugins and themes

commands.usage: studio wp new plugin|theme <slug> [--name "…"] [--template basic|settings|block|rest · block|classic]
commands.description: start an own plugin or theme from a starter (in plugins/<slug> or themes/<slug>, linked into WordPress)

commands.usage: studio wp export <slug> · studio wp log [--tail N] · studio wp login-url [--to /wp-admin/…] · studio wp link · studio wp restart
commands.description: installable zip of an own module, the PHP error log, a signed-in admin address for checks, re-link modules, restart PHP
